datasets.provenance: primary carrier/operator network pages, releases and regulator context
datasets.selection_policy: Capture material digital-backbone routes and network investments that affect VECA east-coast regional connectivity, data-centre geography and resilience. Keep operating terrestrial fibre, planned fibre, network-level reach and domestic subsea diversity as distinct record types.
datasets.completeness_test: Every row must resolve to a primary operator source and preserve operating/planned status plus the published capacity definition. This is not a complete census of all carriers, metro fibre, NBN access infrastructure or cable landing stations.
